request.prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE square 1024x1024 image. The first 4 attached images are STYLE references only (frame, flat shapes, palette); do not copy their birds. The last 1 attached image(s) are earlier versions of this same bird icon: improve on them as the art director's change below says. Save the generated PNG into the current working directory as out.png and reply with only its path. This is variation 1; vary the composition a little. Image brief:
Flat geometric bird icon in a Mondrian / De Stijl spirit, matching the reference images. A thick navy square frame (#0B0F24) around an ivory field (#FAF6EE). Right-facing head-and-upper-breast portrait. The bird is a bold navy silhouette with a few flat color fields; it may run off the bottom and left edges of the frame only, and leaves clear ivory space between the bill tip, crest and the frame. One simple round eye. Use only these colors: navy #0B0F24, ivory #FAF6EE, chrome yellow #F7B902, vermilion #C7301C, Klein blue #002FA7, slate #5E6178. Three or four colors in total. No gradients, shading, texture, outlines of feather detail, scenery, text or labels. Simple shapes that stay readable at 32 pixels.

Species: Black Skimmer (Rynchops niger). Identifying features to show: black cap down to eye level; white lower face, throat and breast; bill red-orange on the base 55%, black tip; lower mandible clearly longer than upper; bill blade-thin, angled slightly down; black back. Proportions measured from a photo: lower mandible to head = 1.45; upper mandible to head = 1.15; bill depth at base to head height = 0.4. Do not draw: bill longer than 1.5x head; mandibles gaping wide apart; orange legs or body color.
Art director's change for this version: Keep the design of the base icon. Make the dark outer part of the bill Klein blue (#002FA7) instead of navy.
